title: 36 Hours in Kailua-Kona
abstract: This seaside city offers plenty of Hawaiian charm, and is within striking distance of lovely beaches, volcanic landscapes and a popular local market.

title: 36 Hours in Chamonix
abstract: Skiers, climbers, foodies and night-life lovers: This French town at the base of a lofty Alps peak welcomes you at its most magical time, the winter.

title: 36 Hours in Anaheim
abstract: Beyond Disneyland, there’s a wealth of wonders hidden in this Southern California city, as long as you know where to look.

title: 36 Hours in Bogotá
abstract: In the Colombian capital: a gallery scene that celebrates local artists, a rapidly evolving food and bar culture, and much else to explore.
